notes: Replies like a friend texting: it puts an emoji on your message (👍 when it starts a job, ✅ when done, ❤️ for thanks), and a "thanks" or "ok" gets just a reaction. Messages you send close together are read together: 2 separate questions get 2 answers, each replying to its own message; a message that only adds to or fixes the first one goes into that answer. Settings → AI → Replies.
